task.title: How to access NC State Data Security Training

steps.step:
If you are required to complete Data Security training, you should already be registered and can access training as described below or as seen here.
Note: New employees may need to register.
Log in to REPORTER with your unity ID and password.
Select the Courses and Events tile on your dashboard.
Find 2026-2027 NC State Data Security Training in the list of courses.
Click Access Online Content to open the online course. A new tab should open directing you to the online course content -- if a tab does not open, please check your popup blocker settings
